name: ChatasBot – Smart Order Notifications for WooCommerce
author: chatasbotofficial

sections.description:
ChatasBot – Smart Order Notifications for WooCommerce allows store owners to send automated WhatsApp-style messages and order alerts directly from WooCommerce.

Connect your store with your ChatasBot account to automate order confirmations, promotions, reminders, and customer communication — all from inside your WordPress dashboard.

✨ Key Features

  • 💬 Send instant WhatsApp-style messages to WooCommerce customers.
  • ⏰ Schedule messages for promotions, offers, and reminders.
  • 📦 Automatically fetch customer phone numbers from WooCommerce orders.
  • 🔐 Secure API connection using your ChatasBot credentials.
  • 📊 View your subscription details, active plan, and message usage.
  • 🧩 Clean, intuitive, and mobile-friendly admin interface.
  • 🧠 Ideal for marketing, customer support, and engagement automation.

🧠 How It Works

  1. Enter your Client ID and API Key in ChatasBot → Settings.
  2. Select phone numbers from WooCommerce orders or add them manually.
  3. Type your message and send it instantly or schedule it for later.
  4. Messages are delivered through the secure ChatasBot API.

🚀 Upcoming Features

  • Automatic order-status notifications (Processing, Completed, Refunded)
  • WhatsApp template and media message support
  • Message logs and analytics dashboard
  • Multi-agent message management

External Service Disclosure

This plugin connects to the external ChatasBot service for message delivery.
When you send or schedule a message, the plugin may transmit order-related data — such as customer name, phone number, order ID, order status, and order total — to:

https://chatasbot.com

This data is used only for generating and delivering WhatsApp-style notifications through your ChatasBot account.

Use of this plugin requires an active ChatasBot account.

  • Website: https://www.chatasbot.com
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.chatasbot.com/privacy-policy/

Please review these policies to ensure compliance with your local data regulations.

Credits

Developed and maintained by Muhammad Hamza Saleemi
https://www.linkedin.com/in/muhammad-hamza-saleemi/

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.

Account Creation Instructions

To use the ChatasBot plugin, you must first create an account on ChatasBot. Follow these steps:

  1. Visit the website https://www.chatasbot.com.
  2. Click on Sign Up and complete the registration process.
  3. After registration, log in to your ChatasBot account and obtain your Client ID and API Key.
  4. Enter these credentials in the ChatasBot → Settings section in the WordPress admin panel.
  5. Start sending automated WhatsApp-style messages to your customers.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/ or install it via the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate it through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to ChatasBot → Settings.
  4. Enter your Client ID, API Key, and optional Base URL.
  5. Start sending or scheduling WhatsApp-style messages to your customers.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin use the official WhatsApp API?

The plugin connects to the ChatasBot platform, which provides its own WhatsApp Business API integration.

Can I send bulk messages?

Yes. You can select multiple customers from your WooCommerce orders or add additional numbers manually.

Do I need a ChatasBot account?

Yes. You must create an account at https://www.chatasbot.com to obtain your API credentials.

Does this plugin store customer data?

No. The plugin does not store or share any customer data outside of what you choose to send through the API.

Is it compatible with all themes?

Yes. It functions entirely within the WordPress admin and does not affect your front-end theme.
